constraints: If resFile is a valid resource file reference number, only that file's resources are listed; if omitted, all currently open resource files are listed.
If predeclared, resIDs must be a Longint array and resNames a String/Text array; otherwise the command creates them as Longint and Text arrays respectively.

overloadMerges.note: Draft blanket-tagged all four params direction:in; the arrow column marks resType (in) and resFile (in, optional) but resIDs/resNames are out (←) -- they are populated by the command, not read from.

params.name: resIDs
params.description: Resource ID numbers for resources of this type

params.name: resNames
params.description: Resource names for resources of this type

params.name: resFile
params.description: Resource file reference number, or all open resource files, if omitted

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Populates resIDs and resNames with the IDs and names of all resources of type resType across open resource files (or one file if resFile is given).
